verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents continuous cloud/SaaS monitoring integrations (AWS, GitHub, Google Workspace) that check configuration/security posture, plus code security CI checks that surface issues in pull requests and DAST application scanning — evidence of ongoing automated checks against connected systems rather than a once-a-year audit. However, there is no explicit documentation of monitoring frequency/cadence (e.g. 'runs every N hours'), no alerting/notification SLA for failing controls, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of how quickly failures actually surface. Missing for 10: documented scan/check frequency or refresh interval, explicit failing-control alerting mechanism and turnaround time, independent verification of near-real-time detection.
